settings.title: PremiumCMS Master
settings.tagline: Control plane — provisions and manages instances

collections.label: Projects
collections.description: Instances provisioned by this control plane. Pick a theme/demo to copy, set a starting balance, and it provisions automatically. Mark 'Is theme/demo' to make this instance itself copyable.

fields.label: Platform domain
fields.description: A hostname on the platform zone to give this instance (e.g. shop.premium-cms.com, or the bare zone). Attached to its Worker and made its canonical URL on save; clear to go back to the p… hostname. Rejected values are cleared (see the plugin log).
